title: Being John Malkovich (bc30)
synopsis: Craig Schwartz is a struggling street puppeteer. He takes a temporary job as a filing clerk at a mysterious company where he discovers a portal to the mind of actor John Malkovich. He then hatches a plan with his beautiful colleague and pet-obsessed wife to let others into John's brain to make money. This celebrated debut collaboration between director Spike Jonze and screenwriter Charlie Kaufman weaves absurdist satire, existential angst, and Kafkaesque surrealism into one.

synopsis_lang.en: Craig Schwartz is a struggling street puppeteer. He takes a temporary job as a filing clerk at a mysterious company where he discovers a portal to the mind of actor John Malkovich. synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 木偶師淪為檔案文員，偶然發現辦公室內一條可直達演員麥高維治大腦意識的神秘通道。他乘機窺探明星生活，體驗 15 分鐘的名利並重拾信心，連同漂亮女同事和癡迷於寵物的老婆，一同借此秘道展開生財大計。各有所需的三人接連進出麥高維治的意識，豈料引發意料之外的混亂四角戀，走向一發不可收拾的局面。由 MV 轉道電影的史碧鍾斯與編劇查理考夫曼首度合作便大放異彩，以荒誕的黑色幽默探討自我與意識的哲學問題。當人人都可成為麥高維治時，「我」還是否存在？

cast: John Cusack, Cameron Diaz, Catherine Keener
